mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UB_MENTOR_BOARD (board_title, board_content, member_number) VALUES (#{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{memberNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_id AS memberId, b.mentorboard_number AS mentorBoardNumber, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, DATE_FORMAT(b.board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, b.board_click AS boardClick FROM UB_MEMBER m JOIN UB_MENTOR_BOARD b ON b.member_number = m.member_number WHERE b.mentorboard_number = #{mentorBoardNumber}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.board_date DESC) AS rnum, m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_id AS memberId, b.mentorboard_number AS mentorBoardNumber, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, DATE_FORMAT(b.board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, b.board_click AS boardClick FROM UB_MEMBER m JOIN UB_MENTOR_BOARD b ON m.member_number = b.member_number ) paged WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
